title: Howson's theorem through finite cores and Kurosh decomposition
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: Formalizes Howson's theorem for finite-rank free groups: the intersection of two finitely generated subgroups is finitely generated. The proof uses the repository's inclusion-compatible Marshall Hall construction to place one subgroup as a free factor of a finite-index overgroup, applies Schreier's finite-index theorem to the other subgroup, and then uses the actual Kurosh decomposition of the resulting subgroup of a binary free product. The final map from the relevant conjugate-intersection factor is defined from the factor inclusions and proved surjective onto the internal subgroup…

formalizes.title: On the Intersection of Finitely Generated Free Groups

review.reason: Formal proof of Howson's theorem on finitely generated subgroups of free groups.
